## AI-Generated Fix (python)

```python
from flask import Flask, render_template_string, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def index():
    if request.method == 'POST':
        user_input = request.form.get('user_input', '')
        # Fix: Use a safe rendering method instead of render_template_string
        return render_template_string('<h1>Hello, {{ user_input | e }}</h1>', user_input=user_input)
    return '''
        <form method="post">
            <input type="text" name="user_input">
            <input type="submit">
        </form>
    '''

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8882)
```

---

## Explanation

The vulnerability was caused by using render_template_string with user input directly, which allowed for Server Side Template Injection (SSTI). The fix involves using the 'e' filter to escape user input, preventing the execution of malicious code.
